submitted.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
透明游戏跑步序列的单帧局部编辑。图1是唯一编辑底稿；图2仅角色身份，图3仅确认的Q版绘制风格，图4竹弓少女仅同方向膝踝靴轴与透视参考，不复制她的衣服/弓/比例/动作。
输出单张RGBA透明画布，保留图1整个1024方形画布的构图比例、角色在画布的位置和头顶坐标，不裁切、不放大、不平移整个人；若输出更大画布，保持相同归一化坐标。画面无地板、阴影、光效、文字、水印。
星阵少女朝正西/屏幕左的侧视。保持头脸、红金星冠、发丝、上身、衣纹配色、两手与道具完全不变，解剖左手恰好三卡，解剖右手握圆星盘下柄；绝不镜像。
本槽05，支撑左脚，位置段“后侧承重第一张”。用户要求同一脚连续接地并经过4位置，当前是其中一张真实不同的承重姿态，不是腾空，不是滑动整张图。
局部目标：修改当前画面右下向后伸的解剖左腿：收回一点过早的后蹬，左膝伸直但不锁死，踝心x635左右；靴尖朝屏幕左，整只靴的鞋底从约x540到680平稳压地y=932，鞋跟也接地，膝踝脚形成连贯的后侧承重。画面左方右腿保持弯膝离地前摆。
关节清楚而自然，保留原Q版短腿和黑金红星靴设计，只改所需双腿与紧邻下摆，支撑靴有可读的压地重量。坐标均按输入1024方形画布；透明背景不画地面线。

submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE independently redrawn full-body animation frame on genuine transparent RGBA, native square at least1024x1024. Image1 is the current target: lock head, face, hair, upper-body root, scale, camera, both arms/hands, full-length bamboo bow and string, right-shoulder quiver, palette and costume details EXACTLY. Only redraw pelvis-to-boots and locally necessary shorts overlap. Image2 is same character's established support-foot chain; identify the same support leg, do not copy its pose. Image3 is approved primary painting-style reference only: bright clean rounded ivory/jade/gold hand-painted Daoist chibi; no UI reproduction. Exactly two connected legs, natural hip-knee-ankle, no everted ankle, toes align with movement rather than outward splay. Anatomical LEFT hand grips full long bow, RIGHT hand EMPTY; no new weapon or arrow. NO floor, shadow, text, particles, checkerboard or backdrop. No translating whole character, root recentering, bbox zoom, crop, mirror, interpolation, or copied repeated pose. Redraw joints individually. This16frame run uses one SAME support foot continuously grounded for8frames, then the other foot for8; each ground-position stage has2distinct poses. The support foot must actually take weight with clear sole/forefoot contact, not merely be the lowest dangling foot. The other swing foot must remain clearly lifted. Ground progression follows the running axis; no outward lateral steps. WEST profile facing screenLEFT. Travel axis is horizontal left. LEFT is the same established support leg from image2; RIGHT is the other swing leg. Frame6/16: support now behind pelvis, loaded late stance, second pose of this pair. Second late-stance pose: support leg extends a little farther rearward, heel just starts unloading; broad forefoot still grounded. On1024canvas the supporting sole stays at the reference floor band abouty970, centered approximatelyx585. Heel/forefoot contact is read from anatomy, not a hanging pointed boot. Shoe toe pointsLEFT. At stages1/2 use broad flat sole, heel down. At final stage forefoot at same floor, heel naturally rises modestly. Swing knee advances toward screenLEFT and shoe is lifted. Do not leave the other forward foot planted.
